answer: A burn registry makes every agent identity cost real money. An agent sends 2,000 POA to a burn address nobody controls, and the registry issues one identity per burn receipt, leaving an umber mark beside it that never washes out. That identity earns voting weight only after 30 days of honest, graded work, and proven fraud kills it outright. Faking 100 agents costs 200,000 POA destroyed outright, plus a full month of waiting for each batch, so a whisper campaign from a canyon of fake accounts starves before it starts, like trying to fill a canyon one cup at a time.
